ns2:course.label: Energy Systems
ns2:course.description: Examines patterns of energy production and utilization and discusses the technical aspects of renewable energy resources, advanced fossil fuel systems, and advanced nuclear systems. Same as GLBL 201. Prerequisite: MATH 220 or MATH 221; one of PHYS 101, PHYS 211, CHEM 104, CHEM 204, ME 300.
